summary: IT Specialist with extensive experience in Army IT infrastructure, project management, systems integration, and engineering support across multiple command and control facilities.

experience.title: Information Technology (IT) Specialist
responsibilities: Developed, managed, and coordinated implementation of network communications, LANs, VIS, and IT infrastructure projects.
Directed a five‑person IPT to implement a $25M IT infrastructure for JSOC C4 facility.
Oversaw development of IT technical requirements, system design plans, contract documents, and design drawings.
Reviewed construction drawings, consolidated change requests, and ensured compliance with technical specifications and security standards.
Represented JSOC and ISEC in project meetings with USACE and other stakeholders.
Created an integrated master schedule (IMS) to manage resources and deliverables.
Coordinated a $19M BRAC‑mandated ARCENT HQ relocation, leading IPT, developing ARP, participating in SSEB, preparing SOWs, procurement data packages, and evaluating contractor performance.
Provided financial and resource planning, execution, and tracking.
Integrated IT subsystems, conducted technical reviews, monitored SAT, and proposed solutions to faults.

experience.title: Systems Integration Analyst
responsibilities: Provided contract IT engineering services for USAISEC.
Developed FDC, SDP, EIP, LOMs, and acquisition documentation for complex IT projects.
Guided and oversaw project document development and validation for FORSCOM and USARC BRAC relocation.
Provided engineering, procurement, installation, cutover, and testing requirements for HF and UHF radio systems and antennas for C4I/IT projects.
Reviewed project documentation and ensured contract deliverables were complete and delivered on time per ARP.

experience.title: Functional Area Expert (Command and Control)
responsibilities: Communications engineer supporting USAISEC, providing quick‑reaction engineering for EFIT total communications at multiple C2 facilities.
Performed QA/QC checks and acceptance testing on C2 facility upgrades and HQ relocations.
Supported US Southern Command HQ relocation, developing FDC for design‑build contracting with USACE.
Developed SDP, LOM, cost estimates, and test plans for radio, satellite, copper/fiber cable plant, lightning protection, grounding, bonding, and shielding systems for DTRA relocation.
Provided on‑site engineering support for voice, data, and VIS installations for USARSO HQ and IMA at Fort Sam Houston.
Engineered design and installation of BDF, conference rooms, command center areas, TRs, and open office areas.
Conducted QA/QC checks and testing for DRSN, GCCS, NIPRNET, SIPRNET, SCI LAN, administrative telephone system, and VIS.
Assisted USAISEC Force Projection Engineering Directorate and 1st Signal Brigade in C2 facility upgrade at 19th Theatre Support Command in South Korea.
Performed site surveys, gathered user requirements, and developed SDP, EIP, LOMs to upgrade GCCS communications and voice systems.
Provided engineering support for C2 facility for USCENTCOM HQ and coalition forces in Doha, Qatar.
Supervised routing, termination, and acceptance testing of fiber optic and Cat5 cabling, voice and data systems, and telecom equipment.
